variants.title: Узкое лицо · русый
variants.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create ONE standalone cinematic casting photograph for ALIVE, widescreen 16:9, highest available native image quality. This is a new fictional casting candidate for Vovik, a boy who is exactly EIGHT years old. It must look like a real ordinary child photographed on a practical film set, not a child fashion advertisement, not a miniature adult, not a caricature.

BOOK INVARIANTS: Eight-year-old child of the cold lower-deck refuge known as the Dark Base. His hair was cut unevenly at home with scissors by an older girl: modest short irregular lengths, an imperfect fringe, plausible ordinary haircut, not a designer haircut or exaggerated comedy. He gets cold easily and sniffs; convey this gently with slightly tucked shoulders and barely pink skin near the nostrils, not illness or gross mucus. A small spontaneous kind smile with lips naturally parted reveals TWO missing upper front milk teeth, normal childhood tooth loss, not damaged or rotten teeth. Small lean child build, narrow shoulders and age-correct neck, head, torso and hands. No obesity, muscularity, emaciation, adult jaw, adult beard or coarse adult skin.

STAGING: Comparable medium portrait from waist to above the head, camera at the child's eye level. He stands centered or just slightly off-center, torso nearly frontal, face turned only a little toward the camera, looking attentively toward an older friend just beside the lens. He cups a small plain stainless-steel mug in both hands near his abdomen to warm them. Hands and fingers anatomically plausible and child-sized. Expression combines earnest curiosity with a little stubbornness, as though he is about to ask a very direct question. A restrained smile, never a huge comic grin or a dramatic crying expression.

WARDROBE PROPOSAL: A washed but worn charcoal-blue sweatshirt over a plain muted gray crew-neck shirt, simple small repaired seam at one elbow, cuffs a little long, practical and modest. No hoodie hood covering the hair, no logos, fantasy costume, jewelry, weapons or luxury fabrics. All six casting candidates use this same wardrobe and setup.

SETTING AND LIGHT: The shared room of a modest inhabited metal space-station refuge, old gray painted metal wall panels, an out-of-focus low table and a small black electric heater with a very subdued amber indicator behind him. The boy is the only person. Background stays secondary. Soft directional neutral practical light from camera-left, gentle fill on the other side, readable skin and both eyes sharply in focus, understated warm background light. Neutral cinematic color, realistic catchlights, individual eyelashes and fine natural hair, subtle youthful skin variation. No coarse pores, beauty airbrushing, fake HDR, oversharpening, grain overlay, painterly textures or excessive bokeh. No outside planet view, no text, captions, watermarks, labels or collage. One image, one child.

DISTINCT CASTING APPEARANCE FOR THIS CANDIDATE:
An ordinary fair-skinned boy with a slightly narrow oval face, gently prominent forehead, gray-blue eyes, a small straight nose and thin relaxed lips. Fine ash-light-brown straight hair in an uneven short scissor cut, a few shorter strands at the left of the fringe. Subtle natural facial asymmetry, realistic modest-sized ears. No resemblance to any existing ALIVE portrait or celebrity.
